name: Tripp Lake Camp
description_short: Traditional full-summer overnight camp for girls ages 7-16 on a lake in Poland, Maine, operating since 1911. Campers stay for the full season, with activities in arts, land sports, waterfront, outdoor living, horseback riding and theatre.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has a mile-long waterfront on Tripp Lake. Campers swim nearly every day, with a scheduled swim period for each age group plus free swim, and move up through colored swim caps as they learn skills. Canoeing, kayaking, sailing, waterskiing and wakeboarding are taught, starting with safety and technique.
